patterns.key_values: compact unified ~40pt, borderless folder SF Symbol leading, centered title, no trailing actions; flat opaque near-black, no glass
timeline editor — time ruler (1.6s ticks) + indigo playhead (line+knob) + stacked colour-coded track lanes; segment hue encodes type (amber=recording, indigo=zoom)
control bar with 3 alignment zones: leading (Auto pop-up + Crop) / center transport triad (rewind/play/forward borderless symbols) / trailing fit-arrows
canvas presentation — recorded window auto-zoomed, rounded, shadowed, padded on full-bleed gradient wallpaper; squircle webcam bubble overlay; dark rounded karaoke caption panel

signature_moves: Padded-wallpaper canvas: recorded window auto-zoomed/rounded/shadowed/floated on a vivid gradient backdrop — the product promise ('beautiful recordings') rendered as the editor surface; dark chrome exists to make it the sole light source
Semantic timeline hue language: amber/gold = source recording, electric indigo = zoom/effect — type readable at a glance with no legend
Committed brand accent (indigo #4429F3) replacing the system accent across zoom clips + playhead; systematic, matches the app icon
Effect-as-content grammar: zooms/captions are selectable timeline blocks with inline settings glyphs, not modal dialogs
Near-black figure-ground discipline: chrome/timeline/bezels all within a few % of #0C0D0F so nothing competes with the canvas
defects: Contrast Dilution (UI, mild) — Auto/Crop control bezels (translucent white ~6-8% + hairline border on near-black) likely fall under the 3:1 non-text floor; read as faint ghosts. Consistent with 'recede all but the canvas' logic but still a WCAG non-text miss
Ruler label legibility (borderline) — ~10-11pt time labels in low tertiary gray on black sit near the 4.5:1 small-text floor

aesthetic.direction: dark prosumer creative tool / 'editor-noir' — near-black committed chrome as ground, saturated content as figure

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect — the beautiful padded-canvas presentation is the entire trust proposition; polish reads as capability
Von Restorff / isolation effect — the two saturated clip hues (amber, indigo) pop against near-black, making timeline objects instantly salient
Figure-ground (Gestalt) — dark UI recedes as ground so the colourful canvas advances as figure
Jakob's Law — standard macOS chrome + familiar transport controls (rewind/play/forward) keep learning cost near zero
Hick's Law — minimal visible control set and an 'Auto' preset pop-up collapse decisions; complexity lives in the timeline, not the chrome
Miller's chunking — control bar grouped into a leading/center/trailing triad rather than an undifferentiated row
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: the only image is a MARKETING COMPOSITE. Left half is brand evidence (pure-black backdrop #0A0A0A, purple-gradient ring icon, 'Screen Studio' wordmark, bold white 'Beautiful screen recordings in minutes' headline) — do NOT feed to app UI canon. Right half is the app window, which bleeds off the right edge and is rendered at ~0.77x scale (traffic-light cluster ~41px vs native ~52-54pt) so ALL pixel values are estimated with wide ranges. SECOND CRITICAL caveat: the Linear-looking dark UI *inside the canvas frame* (sidebar with Inbox/My issues/Views/Roadmaps, issue list, All/Backlog/Active/Closed tabs) is RECORDED CONTENT being edited, NOT Screen Studio's own design — none of Linear's sidebar/list/selection styling was attributed to Screen Studio. Consequently native-tells #3 (selection) and #4 (sidebar headers) are unjudgeable for this app. Only one surface, dark only; no settings/empty-state/light-mode/focus evidence. Lineage 'native' rests on chrome tells + external knowledge that Screen Studio is a native AppKit app; confidence med because the editor body is almost entirely custom-drawn. Era tagged big-sur (rounded-rect bezels, flat opaque dark chrome, no Liquid Glass) though the app wears a heavy custom creative-tool theme — 'custom' is an equally defensible era read.
